notes: Not automated: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Straw Hat Crew} type and the number of DON!! cards on your field is at least 6 less than the number on your opponent's field, draw 3 cards and trash 2 cards from your hand. Then, add up to 4 DON!! cards as rested from your DON!! deck.
